Thanks for the heads up — agree with Mina.

Rationale for IC5 (Senior):
- Role needs deep runtime inference experience (attention optimizations, KV cache, batching) but we're not asking for large-scale architecture leadership day 1.
- Candidates at IC5 can independently own a service and mentor juniors — match for immediate ramp.

Suggested interview loop (target 2 weeks from posting):
1) Recruiter screen (30m) — GreenGate
2) Hiring manager tech screen (60m) — Karthik
3) System design / infra deep-dive (75m) — Marissa + Senior SWE
4) Ops/Oncall & tradeoffs panel (45m) — SRE rep
5) Debrief / comp calibration (30m)

I've attached an updated interview-panel-rubric-v2.docx with suggested questions and a shortened loop for candidate experience. If we compress the loop we can still do quality filtering while moving faster.

Approve the open req for IC5. Pushing to People Ops once Vivek confirms budget.
